historyTimeline.h2: Land Rover Discovery 300Tdi - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the 300Tdi engine was introduced to the Land Rover Discovery Series I, it represented a significant refinement over the earlier 200Tdi, bringing improved intercooling, better refinement, and enhanced durability to the iconic 4x4.

milestones.description: 300Tdi (2.5L Turbo Diesel), 111hp, introduced to the Discovery Series I, featuring an intercooler, revised cylinder head, and improved fuel injection over the 200Tdi.
End of 300Tdi production in the Discovery, replaced by the TD5 engine in the Series II, though the 300Tdi architecture remained in the Defender until 2006.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Land Rover Discovery 300Tdi is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Land Rover Discovery 300Tdi Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Land Rover Discovery 300Tdi is widely regarded as one of the most robust and mechanically simple diesel engines Land Rover ever produced. However, age-related wear on specific components is inevitable. Rebuilt engines sourced through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Head Gasket Failure - Why the Land Rover Discovery 300Tdi Suffers Thermal Stress
problems.rootCause: Original factory plastic cylinder head locating dowels can shear under thermal stress, allowing head movement and subsequent gasket failure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing the gasket and upgrading to steel locating dowels to prevent recurrence.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly recommended preventative fix if caught before severe block warping.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the block or head has warped beyond machining limits.

problems.recommendation: For minor injector leaks or early head gasket seepage, targeted specialist repair with steel dowel upgrades is highly cost-effective. However, if the engine has suffered catastrophic overheating or severe head corrosion, a full rebuilt engine with all modern upgrades is the most reliable long-term solution to protect your classic Discovery.

problems.group: Injector Seal Leaks & Return Pipe Failure
problems.h4: Injector Seal Leaks & Return Pipe Failure - Why the Land Rover Discovery 300Tdi Suffers "Black Death"
problems.rootCause: Aging copper injector seats and brittle plastic fuel return pipes allow combustion gases and fuel to escape, creating severe carbon buildup around the injectors.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing copper seats, seals, and upgrading to modern braided return pipes.
repairOptions.longevity: Essential routine maintenance for any classic 300Tdi.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if severe "black death" has caused irreversible cylinder head corrosion or cracking.
